verdict.rationale: Latham's own Emerging Companies & Growth page says it is present in US and global venture hubs including London, Hong Kong, and Singapore, and that it advises on hundreds of financings a year. That points to multi-jurisdiction venture reach, but the page never actually describes cross-border deals. missing for 10: documented international-investor representations, flip/redomiciliation work, specific multi-jurisdiction financing examples, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings

citations.quote: As the only global law firm present in all key US and global venture and growth capital hubs — from the Bay Area, Austin, and Boston to London, Hong Kong, and Singapore
we advise on hundreds of emerging company financings totaling billions of dollars every year.
